beats.text: Sending $200 home averages 2.8%. To Cuba, the fee is 19.6%.
Cuba is the world's highest, where fees take nearly a fifth of every transfer.
Major recipients pay far less: Mexico is 2.7%, and India is 1.8%.
Other costly transfers climb fast: Benin at 17.4%, Angola at 12.8%, Sierra Leone at 10.3%, and Tajikistan at 10.3%.
Near the bottom, Croatia drops to 0.3%.
How much does it cost to send money to your family?
